title: Audio memory seek callback
summary: Recovered cdecl callback at VA 0x55dd90: origins 0/1/2 set the cursor from absolute/current/length bases with modulo-2^32 arithmetic; other origins return the unchanged cursor. Writes only context +0x34. Registration and indirect callers establish the callback ABI; neighboring read callback establishes length +0x30 and buffer +0x2c.
test_description: Direct original comparison over 3584 combinations of eight lengths, eight cursors, eight signed displacements and seven origins, plus eight sequential seeks. Checks return bits, complete context and surrounding canaries, unchanged length/opaque fields, and FS head restoration after each original call. Covers negative offsets, invalid origins, out-of-range cursors, zero lengths and signed/unsigned wrapping.
known_limits: Partial context layout only; full owning class and decoder remain outside scope.
Return signedness is represented as raw uint32_t EAX bits; decoder callers sometimes interpret these as signed.
Invalid context pointers and concurrent access are outside the valid calling contract.
No byte-matching claim or full audio integration validation.
